hook.name: LayerMemeHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for LayerMeme token pools that applies configurable per-direction static LP fees (separate rates for buying vs. selling the LayerMeme token) via updateDynamicLPFee, and collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap through delta adjustments. Includes a time-limited (2-minute) MEV protection module and supports optional pool extensions.
